nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Fill these once. igUserId = Instagram Business account id linked to the Page; fbPageId = the Page id. supabaseBucket must be a PUBLIC bucket.

nodes.name: Fetch publishing queue
nodes.notes: GET /api/editorial/queue on the tracker → { jobs: [...] }, one job per (post, platform) due now.

nodes.name: Download from Google Drive
nodes.notes: The n8n Google account must be able to read the file (shared with it, or the file's owner).

nodes.name: Route by platform
nodes.notes: Matches the platform NAME as typed in the tracker (case-insensitive): Instagram, Facebook, YouTube. Anything else (e.g. TikTok) is reported back as unsupported.

nodes.name: Upload to Supabase Storage
nodes.notes: Meta needs a public, direct URL. Upsert by post id → re-runs overwrite the same object.

nodes.notes: Images: image_url. Videos: published as Reels (video_url). Returns a container id that must finish processing before publishing.

nodes.notes: Loops back to the wait while IN_PROGRESS, up to ~15 × 20 s = 5 min.

nodes.name: FB: publish
nodes.notes: Photo → /photos (url, message). Video → /videos (file_url, description). Needs pages_manage_posts + pages_read_engagement on the Page token.

parameters.content:
## The One — social publisher
Every 15 min: tracker queue → Google Drive → Supabase re-host → Instagram / Facebook / YouTube → result back to the tracker.

**Before activating**
1. Fill **Config** (tracker URL, IG business id, FB page id, Supabase URL + public bucket).
2. Credentials: Tracker bearer (= AUTOMATION_SECRET), Google Drive OAuth2, Supabase header auth (`Authorization: Bearer <service_role key>`), Meta Page token (Facebook Graph API credential), YouTube OAuth2.
3. In the tracker, a post publishes when it has a date, platforms and a **media link**.

Platform names in the tracker must be *Instagram*, *Facebook*, *YouTube* (case-insensitive). TikTok is reported as unsupported.
